title: $5 a Day for 30 Years = $186,000? Here's the Math #shorts
description:
$5 a day is about $152 a month. Over 30 years you put in $54,750. Kept in a jar, that's all you have. Invested at an example 7% a year, it grows to about $185,537: $26,323 after 10 years, $79,224 after 20, and the last 10 years alone add about $106,000, more than the first 20 years combined. Ten more years (40 in total): about $399,190.

Math: $5 x 365 / 12 = $152.08 a month, invested monthly, 7% a year compounded monthly. 7% is a common long-run illustration, not a promise: real returns vary year to year and can be negative. Taxes, fees and inflation are not included.
